reason: GWINS 21826 exposes the real source text and Odysee/Rumble media URLs but no usable source-side timestamps were found in the retrieved public page. A bounded public GHOT search did not yield a reliable E006 timing record; this is recorded only as not found in the checked surface, not as proof of GHOT absence. The current host cannot perform local media ASR/playback extraction from the linked media, so assigning start_sec/end_sec would be speculative.
resolution: Release this alignment claim for a runtime that can inspect the public media and perform local ASR/playback when public timing remains inadequate. Do not infer GHOT absence and do not create synthetic timestamps.
